description: MVP ICP for Charity Commission filing corpus — targets persons with trustee/director roles, donor history, or board membership across multiple organisations, excluding generic service providers.

qualifying_signals.description: Named as trustee of a charity or trust (TRUSTEE_OF edge)
Named as director of a company (DIRECTOR_OF edge)
Named as donor in a donation event (MADE_DONATION edge with amount/date)
Named in board/committee membership context without explicit trustee/director title
Person appears across 2+ distinct charity/company filings

disqualifying_signals.description: Identified as accountant, auditor, or reporting accountant for the filing entity
Identified as solicitor or legal adviser to the filing entity
Named as bank nominee, custodian, or institutional holder
Named as investment manager or fund manager providing services to the entity
Identified as insurance broker, property agent, payroll provider, or other arms-length service role
Entity is a company/firm name rather than a person (e.g. 'Buzzacott LLP', 'Barclays Bank PLC')

affinity_indicators.description: Candidate and seed both serve as trustees of the same charity
Candidate and seed both serve as directors of the same company
Candidate donated to a charity where the seed is a trustee or director
Candidate and seed both donated to the same charity
Candidate and seed named in the same filing document

capacity_indicators.description: Donation amounts directly attributed to the person in filing text
Number of distinct charities/trusts where the person serves as trustee
Person is connected to a grant-making foundation or trust (as trustee or donor)
Person holds a senior company directorship (chair, CEO, managing director)

influence_indicators.description: Person holds trustee or director roles at 3+ organisations
Person holds chair, vice-chair, treasurer, secretary, or named officer role
Person named across filings from 3+ distinct organisations
Person appears in filings spanning 3+ years for the same organisation
